name: Dialog portraits
author: PokePat
description: Shows a 64×64 picture of the person who speaks above the message box – on the left or on the right, mirrored if you like – and bigger pictures (up to 128×96, e.g. a map or a letter) in the middle of the screen. Portraits and pictures are added in PokePat from any PNG or from a trainer picture; they disappear by themselves when the message box closes.

edits.text:
def_special ShowPortrait
	def_special HidePortrait
	def_special ShowPortraitAt
	def_special ShowPicture
	def_special HidePicture

usage: In the event builder use the blocks "Show portrait" (left/right, mirrored), "Hide portrait", "Show picture" and "Hide picture". In a script: setvar VAR_0x8004, PORTRAIT_X / special ShowPortrait – or additionally setvar VAR_0x8005, PORTRAIT_POS_RIGHT / special ShowPortraitAt; pictures: setvar VAR_0x8004, PICTURE_X / special ShowPicture. Add portraits and pictures under Mods → Dialog portraits.
